This is Marvin.[/p][p][/p][p]If this is your first time hearing from me, here's a quick intro. I'm not a developer or a designer. I'm just a regular person who helps test gameplay and talks with survivors, media folks, curators, and YouTubers. AJ is the one who actually designs, builds, and directs the game. Right now, AJ is on leave (not exactly by choice).[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, we have some news to share.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Website for Achievers and Explorers[/b][/p][p]Since I can't make games myself, I do what I can. That usually means typing. I've been making the [b][url="https://ffnuniversedb.myportfolio.com/"]FFN Universe DB[/url][/b], and I'm updating it regularly. I hope it helps as you explore Lumainaho State.[/p][p][/p][p]Everything on the site, including images and text, is free to use as long as it's not for commercial purposes. Feel free to use any of it for your blogs, wikis, articles, or whatever else you're working on.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]We Moved Offices[/b][/p][p]We relocated from a cold, snowy, tree-filled town (not in Idaho) to a warmer, coastal one (not in Florida). This wasn't a scouting trip for new content. AJ's health hadn't been great, and the cold wasn't helping. [/p][p][/p][p]There are no gators or tornadoes here, and no Florida men either, but it is still a coastal city. If AJ ends up staying here long-term, that might help later when we begin developing Flostarida as a future update. [/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of Flostarida: Flostarida, where Rose grew up, is planned to be the next major state added after New Eve City in [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245930/Flaming_Friday_Night/"]Flaming Friday Night[/url][/b]. It won't be featured in FFN: EVE. Once the Lumainaho storyline wraps up in FFN: EVE, we're planning to introduce a new state set in the U.S. Midwest. No release date yet, though.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]So When Will AJ Be Back?[/b][/p][p]I don't know. Maybe soon. But if we're unlucky, it might take longer.[/p][p][/p][p]I would like to say more, but there's a press embargo in place. We're not the ones who control it. It's being handled by a certain gentleman. And I'm not him.[/p][p][/p][p]Judging by the way things are going, it feels like it could be soon. Some parts of the embargo are already being lifted, just not the most important one yet. Once that last piece is lifted, AJ should be able to return within two months.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a vague hint: what's currently happening in the desert veined with black gold is indirectly but significantly connected to all of this.[/p][p][/p][p]AJ is resting and gradually preparing to return to work. What's left now is the gentleman's final decision, and it's not ours to make. Over the past six months, AJ and AJ's neighbors have done everything they could.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, as we mentioned in a recent YouTube post, once AJ returns, FFN: EVE may shift to seasonal updates. This would help create a healthier development cycle and offer a better experience for survivors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for sticking with us. Your support really does make a difference.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned. Maybe your frequency should be set to Washington, D.C.[/p][p][/p][p]With gratitude,[/p][p]Marvin[/p][p]FFN Team[/p]

notes.title: Frozen April News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9ce147dfefa00e38b5fdc7403ab60029b6bc93f3.png[/img]

Hello, this is AJ, the designer and developer behind FFN: EVE.

Updates for FFN: EVE may resume within the next two months (or, if things go well, within three weeks).

Honestly, my neighbors and I thought our issues would have been resolved a month ago, but things actually got worse.

What I can tell you for sure is that by the start of this summer, a huge six- to seven-month-long ordeal will come to an end. To be honest, there is a very small chance that things could turn out worse than they are now. If that happens, I might not be able to continue making games. However, there is a high probability that we will overcome this, thanks to the strong and kind neighbors from the faraway city, just like Rose, John, and Jane once helped out Huckletwain. So please, do not worry too much.

I might explain more later, but even though I have not been able to work on the FFN Universe for five months, that time was not wasted. I learned many important things that will help not just in life, but also in design techniques, and the creation of the FFN Universe.

Anyway, if everything ends on a happy note, I will be able to start working on the FFN Universe again. We had prepared a lot of festive content for last winter, but we really did not anticipate something this big happening. So, if I can return to work, you will likely see small updates released throughout the rest of the year, rather than major new content. (We are just about seven months away from 2026!) These updates might include improving UX design to be kinder to new survivors, fixing bugs that cause headaches, and making Huckletwain feel more lively.

Of course, a new village and new enemies have also been waiting for you (for a long time).

(And if I can make games again,) we are also planning to release a small new project that we have been working on since last year.

I hope I can bring you better news next time. I really have so many stories I want to share with you all.

Stay healthy, stay calm, and stay strong. Thank you so much, as always.

With gratitude,
AJ
FFN Team

notes.title: Off The Record
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=mFpliZ6Aqa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey, Marvin here.

Today, I wanna talk to you in a more relaxed tone.

The Frozen March News might be coming soon, but before that, there's something I wanna share. So here I am.


[b]About the FFN Team[/b]
As some of you might have guessed, our team is small. Just three members: Designer AJ, Yume, and me. In reality, AJ develops almost everything alone, while Yume handles Japanese localization. Both Yume and I help with testing and customer support.

But right now, things ain't going so well. Yume had to return home to care for her sick sister, which requires a lot of attention. (Japanese localization is still on track. This is 2025, after all.)

And then, there's AJ.





[b]What's Going on with AJ?[/b]
It's hard to talk about this openly because it's sensitive, and AJ might talk about it in a few years. But here's what I can say.

For the past eight years, AJ's work on the FFN Universe has been interrupted by a major external obstacle. A few years ago, it led to an economic crisis, which, fortunately, has been overcome. But a deeper, fundamental problem remained.

AJ thought this issue was completely resolved three years ago, but it wasn't. Like an incurable cancer, it grew back rapidly, returning like Voldemort three months ago. To be exact, a man discovered it and told AJ. Now, AJ has no choice but to face it head-on, along with AJ’s neighbors.

Right now, AJ is away, working to "debug" this real-life fatal bug with some "friendly neighbors." AJ's like "Life has basically turned into a huge noir open-world game, and the massive, dramatic historical event happening now. That'll be the final story of the FFN Universe."

Actually, AJ has been up every day, too pumped to rest. Even though it's a serious crisis, AJ sees it as a once-in-a-lifetime experience that's priceless in its own way. That said, AJ's immunity has dropped from lack of sleep this winter, and AJ's health ain't great.

The good news? This “main quest” in AJ's life is expected to be completed within two weeks or a month. Once it's over, AJ can finally create all the FFN Universe projects as planned, and at a much faster pace than before. (Because this time, the huge obstacle will be completely gone.)

In the meantime, it's just me left running things. Feels like Tom Hanks on an island, talking to Wilson every day. That's why I'm really glad whenever I receive a review, email, or message from y'all.






[b]About the Difficulty[/b]
AJ knows. AJ's heard it several times: the game's too difficult.

The last time we talked about it was three months ago. AJ's stance is firm: FFN: Eve is a horror game at its core, and the villains won't be nerfed into buffoons just to make things easier (even if that brings thumbs-down reviews).

AJ may want survivors to feel indescribable catharsis when they finally defeat the enemies, like pushing through that one last rep in a brutal workout. (Maybe "Motherfxxker," a line from Rose, captures that feeling.)

If you're struggling, there are some guide vids on YouTube by veteran survivors. Worth checking out.

That said, difficulty is AJ's personal design choice. As someone who tests the games, I was really annoyed.

I once asked, "Why do I die in just one hit?"

AJ's like, "If you get shot or stabbed once or twice in real life, you'd die too."

So I fired back, "Then why the hell doesn't Santa die easily?"

And completely serious, AJ replied, "He's wearing state-of-the-art tactical body armor. Or maybe his suit is bulletproof, like John Wick's."

I had no comeback.

Honestly, AJ always does this. The Way Home, our second game, was just insane. Wouldn't necessarily recommend it unless you're really curious. Back then, Yume literally sobbed while playing it, and AJ was just like "The subject of this game is about total irrationality."

I have nothing more to say. AJ's brain works in ways I can't explain, and I mean that in the best way possible.






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/c9f7d8339794ac790333650fb230847239f38b0e.png[/img]
[b]About the FFN Lineup[/b]
We sometimes get inquiries from fans and visitors about Flaming Friday Night, FFN: Eve updates, and upcoming projects.

There are 14 planned FFN works that I know of. AJ will reveal specific details soon, but for now, I can say this:

Every story is already fully outlined. Many elements haven't even been revealed yet. The only thing AJ needs is time to create the world. One thing is certain: AJ will spend the rest of AJ's life making games, unless something threatens that goal.





Keep your fingers crossed for AJ and AJ's "friendly neighbors." Everyone's waiting for their return.

I'm bored as hell these days and want things back on track ASAP.

Can't say "We'll be back" or even "We'll be right back" this time. But what I can say is:

We hope all of you stay happy and healthy, wherever you are. And yeah, this might sound like boomer talk, but love yourself, your neighbors, your friends, your family, and your home.

And I truly mean that.



Regards,
Marvin

notes.title: Noirvember Q&A (Developer Responses)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=d2_5VB6pPqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, this is AJ, the designer and developer behind FFN EVE.

Did you have a fun Halloween? I hope you enjoyed it.

Thank you very much for your continued interest in the game. In this Q&A session, I'll answer questions sent by email and others gathered from external platforms and the Steam Community. 


[b]Rose's eye color seems too desaturated, which gives off a scary vibe. Was this intentional?[/b]

No, that was my mistake. Originally, a higher-saturation version existed, but I ended up using a desaturated one. At the time, it was the end of the year, and I may have been drinking a lot during the holiday celebrations, like Rose was. If I had noticed right after release, I would have corrected it quickly. But now, adjusting her eye color would take a lot of time, given how many animations feature Rose. Instead, we'll reflect this aspect in Rose's backstory. (Apologies to her.)



[b]When will the finale update be released?[/b]

We're aiming for three to five years at the latest and two years at the earliest. The complete storyline has already been written. (We're prioritizing steady updates to FFN: EVE while also preparing the next project and a re-release of Flaming Friday Night.)



[b]When will Pandu become a playable character?[/b]

Soon. Pandu will be playable by the end of the year or around New Year's. However, some combat experiences, such as crocodile hunting and the Mr. Brandon Raid, will be available later. We are planning unique experiences for Pandu, distinct from Rose's journey. Additionally, Rose and Pandu will have many conversations about each other.



[b]Is this game entirely roguelike?[/b]

Not exactly, though it includes some roguelike elements. Certain objects respawn at random locations, and you can play in permadeath mode if you prefer. There aren't any other roguelike elements, other than these. (TMI: I thought about having enemies drop weapons with random reinforcement levels, but I ended up discarding the idea. Other important updates are still in the works and awaiting release.) We're designing FFN: EVE with a focus on action, character development, and story progression, rather than aiming for a roguelike experience.



[b]Are the state and city names meant to represent actual locations, or are they fictional?[/b]

They represent real states and cities. You can consider the FFN universe to be a parallel world.

Seasprinkle = Seattle
Lumainaho = Idaho
NEC = NYC
Las Melodias = Las Vegas
Flostarida = Florida



[b]Are there plans to support other languages?[/b]

Of course, we'd like to support other languages. However, adding even one more language requires a lot of effort and time (thanks to Yume for translating Japanese). It seems difficult to support other languages until the finale update is completed.



[b]What do you usually smoke? (Frequently Asked Question)[/b]

Nothing. Sometimes, I enjoy a can of Asahi draft beer. When the weather is nice, I like to go running. Every evening, I take a warm shower, and afterward, I enjoy warm water and chocolate.





Thank you for your continued interest and support. We'll be right back.




Best regards,
FFN Team

notes.title: Buck or Buckshot Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Good evening, survivors. Marvin here.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1870180/view/4178856034941685242]The major update, "Buck or Buckshot," was released[/url] a few days ago, bringing multiple new user experiences to the Friday nights. I'd like to provide a more detailed account of the changes and additions included in this update.








[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/6501716febe0f084714a67c97c625bc7f32726a0.gif[/img]

[b]New Enemy: Saltwater Crocodiles[/b]

Our main designer, AJ, added these creatures. Initially, we had planned to introduce criminals like gangsters or thugs, but AJ wanted to expedite the update. To do this, we recycled some legacy graphic resources from our debut, Flaming Friday Night.

At first, I was opposed to the idea, "Crocodiles in the Northwestern United States? In winter? That doesn't seem appropriate." AJ replied, "This is America, so it makes sense." In the end, I was persuaded.






 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/e058317b955fd2253364803ac31dc6d7cf2b5800.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9bed60a416a3c7d470d8c419caaa453bdb351d2a.gif[/img]

Anyway, once you get and read the crocodile hunting guide book, you'll be able to escape when bitten by them, except when your HP is gone. Their bite damage is deadly, so do your best to avoid getting bitten.









[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/ddc6bfdb54b658a2e396323494101f3a549b71b9.png[/img]

[b]Debuff and Buffs: Frost, Bonfire, Pizza[/b]

Yeah, Rose and Pandu bolted out of the bloody house wearing nothing but the party costumes, so they must be freezing.

The frost in the wilderness continually damages you survivors and slows you down when your Frost Resistance isn't high enough.







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5fe6a924e70f3254ccf5e02d28ee3726c8996838.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9d521f1375bc5cdf4ead1017781537dab3978495.gif[/img]

To deal with this, grab some pizza slices and warm up by the bonfire to boost your Frost Resistance.

Of course, other methods to increase it will be added later.









[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/26edf6f5bd03cba61f50f47092af974d2643f284.png[/img]

[b]Level and Status System Now Displayed and Available[/b]

Actually, these values have already existed since FFN EVE released. Just the Santa's lovely axe is really deadly, and Rose's HP couldn't cover it. Still can't, though.


That's right, we released Frozen Friday Night: The Eve as a Horror Action Noir Western RPG, not a casual simple game. That's why we're still constructing the night.

Then, we finally added the Seasprinkle University Student ID Card to display survivor's data.



💪 Agility
It affects increasing Evade Chance.

Agility will affect reducing cooldown of dash, and others in the future.


💪 Intelligence
It influences the amount of XP gained.

Survivor can increase Intelligence through reading most books.

Intelligence will provide additional benefits for survivors in the future, especially for Pandu.


💪 Concentration
It affects increasing Accuracy and Deadly Hit.

Concentration will provide additional benefit for survivors in the future.


💪 Endurance
It affects increasing HP, Speed, and Sanity.


💪 Speed
An essential attribute in the scary game.


💪 Strength
It affects increasing melee weapon damage.


💪 Sanity
When you encounter an enemy with an overwhelming level difference, the body may freeze if Sanity is low. That means we'll add the first raid boss battle soon.





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/26feff0220f8b4aceed936c55b511cb940cbaf08.gif[/img]

💪 Luck
It affects increasing Accuracy, Deadly Hit and Evade Chance.

And Luck also affects the chance to obtain more currency or ammo from wooden crates and to discover a four-leaf clover!

You can increase Luck whenever you discover four-leaf clovers.


💪 Armor
Armor reduces damage taken. Lower Armor value reduces more damage.


💪 Frost Resistance
An essential attribute when you're exploring Whispering Sunrise Forest and when you don't want to die by heart attack while drinking like a fish in holiday seasons.


💪 Accuracy
Higher Accuracy means fewer missed attacks.


💪 Evade Chance
Higher Evade Chance means you're more likely to evade enemy attacks when you're hit.


💪 Killing Power
It affects increasing survivor's damage output.


💪 Deadly Power
It's Critical Damage.


💪 Deadly Hit
It's Critical Hit.


💪 Cruelty
It affects increasing Deadly Power.


💪 Notoriety
We'll explain about Notoriety later.







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/089b121f3f81144e8eea827dae9fd6c38daf43b8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/78cc530b364a5d78efb90c4fb0511dc0c8a946bd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/b97b3ca8cfe42f46ea3e97b16868323f801ba89c.gif[/img]

🔥 Level and XP
You'll gain XP whenever you defeat crocodiles or the Santa Mask Suit in nightmares, which will increase your level.


🔥 Level Up Benefits
1. Restores HP to full.
2. Increases HP slightly.
3. Increases Concentration slightly.
4. Increases Sanity slightly.
5. (If survivor is armed with a firearm) Increases Agility slightly.
6. (If survivor is armed with a melee weapon) Increases Strength slightly.


Survivors will also be able to increase Agility, Strength, and most other stats not only through leveling up but also through other means in the future.


The maximum level you can currently reach is 5.








[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/6c5ec1ac0320cffd0c5c2b7632e920d908f841d4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/fe0c0593ec9f82ebc767c6de50461a0d611af51f.gif[/img]

[b]Evasion (Miss) System[/b]

Survivor and enemies now have a chance to evade when they're hit. If evasion is successful, the Miss visual effects will be shown.











[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/dbd31c17bee76649d37c378d41a5737b887b31bd.gif[/img]

[b]Ways to Restore HP[/b]

🍕 Sleeping
It's free and provides fast restoration, but you have to say hello to the Santa Mask Suit in the nightmare.

🍕 Bonfire
It's free and offers slower restoration than sleeping, but also provides the buff that increases your Frost Resistance after waiting a few seconds.

🍕 Leveling Up
It's free, but you need to gain XP.

🍕 Pizzas
Requires payment. Increases Frost Resistance as well.

🍕 First Aid Kit
Requires payment or can be found randomly in wooden crates in the woods.







[b]Ways to Save Data[/b]

The data is saved when you move to another place, sleep, press the ESC key, or die.







[b]Ways to Get Money[/b]

Apologies, we intended to add looting content from crocodiles and minor quests in this update. Unfortunately, we didn't!

For now, you can loot dollars only from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1870180/view/4190115667791559192]dead gangsters[/url] and wooden crates. Still then, someone may have lost a modest amount of money for the Whispering Sunrise Forest explorer beginners.







[b]Mute Function for BGM and SFX[/b]

We need it when recording videos for trailers.

Survivors will use it when you'd like to listen to old jazz, EDM, rock, classic, and other genres of music while hunting crocodiles.

You can also mute it when you're just doing other tasks on the internet, leaving Rose to stand in front of the bonfire, which can increase your playtime. This may help expose Frozen Friday Night: The Eve on Steam more frequently. Appreciate it in advance!

To mute BGM and SFX, simply press the ] or [ key.







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/866b05ca256e0a50e0df3b85f5d7b769086f8762.gif[/img]

[b]Perks[/b]

We added perks for our crocodile hunters. By hunting crocodiles multiple times, you'll unlock more beneficial perks. I felt it's really easy to slain these beasts once I became crocodile hunter professional. But it's not essential tasks, so don't feel burden to earn all perks. 






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5732b4d73432b01813714e819b68400298e55413.png[/img]

[b]Steam Rich Presence Strings[/b]

Show your Steam friends what you're up to in Frozen Friday Night: The Eve, just like IG.
